name: FFS_CATALOG
description: Contains a list of created catalogs.

columns.name: VERSION_GUID
columns.description: Reference to FFS_CATALOG_VERSION of the catalog. Last successfully uploaded version.

columns.name: INSTANCE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the environment the catalog belongs to.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique short text identifier of the catalog.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Catalog name will be shown for user.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Time when the catalog was created.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Last update time of the catalog.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Information from where catalog is uploaded.

columns.name: CATALOG_SCM_ID
columns.description: Reference to corresponding FFS_CATALOG_SCM or NULL.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
